text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days before the Aoba Sho, Mejiro 
Ardan was studying the races of Sakura 
Chiyono O and Yaeno Muteki.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was rare for her to care so much about 
other Umamusume with her target race right 
around the corner. That only went to show 
just how special those two were to her...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Mejiro Ardan maintained that her 
goal was ultimately to surpass her 
sister's glory, turning her focus for the 
moment toward the Aoba Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—And so came the day of the Aoba Sho. Free 
of overconfidence, Mejiro Ardan faced the 
race with total composure.
